acceptance.criterion_verbatim: row DSGN_REBRND-S1. Render /attribution with a POPULATED fixture, and for every divergence bar measure the label's bounding box against the centre ornament's, writing each pair and its overlap_px to .scratch/rb-s-9-label-collision.json. Every pair must read overlap_px: 0, and the pair set must be NON-EMPTY -- an empty set would pass vacuously, and a skeleton render produces exactly that. Measure both a small tilt (narrow bar, the failing case) and a large one.
